title: The Cosmic Dipole Anomaly as Regime-Dependent Anisotropy in Energy-Flow Cosmology
abstract: Working note that proposes a natural EFC mechanism for the excess galaxy number-count dipole (2–3× kinematic). In EFC, large-scale isotropy is a regime condition; a residual super-Hubble entropy gradient ∇S modulates the effective coupling G_eff(S) and thus structure growth, yielding a dipole aligned with the CMB but with amplified amplitude. The note derives the leading-order dipole, estimates the required ~2% entropy gradient, and states falsifiable predictions and open gaps.
